# LMD sample puzzles with Penpa+ solve links

Date: 2026-11-13. Sample puzzles for the solve-UI prototypes, chosen so that the prototypes are judged on genres other than sudoku.

Method: for each genre, the LMD tag listing `https://logic-masters.de/Raetselportal/Suche/erweitert.php?tag_id=<tag>&chlang=en` (newest first, 20 per page). The same search narrowed to text mentioning Penpa (`&skname=x&sktext=x&suchtext=penpa`, the form a short link on an LMD page used) found the puzzles with Penpa+ links far more cheaply. Then each puzzle page (`/Raetselportal/Raetsel/zeigen.php?id=<id>&chlang=en`) was opened, newest first, preferring no Sudoku tag (1001), low or medium difficulty and small size. Tag ids and URL shapes come from `grid-hunts` `docs/research/2026-09-14-lmd-hybrid-scan.md` and `archive/finders/lmd-hybrid-scan/`. Short links (tinyurl.com) were followed by one `curl` each.

Politeness: 60 requests to logic-masters.de in total, one at a time, at least 10.5 s apart, no retries (none failed), User-Agent `penpa-fork-sample-collector/1.0`.

Answer check: each Penpa+ link was opened in headless Chromium (Playwright from `~/src/sudokupad-scripts/node_modules`) against this fork's `docs/` served by `python3 -m http.server`, at `http://127.0.0.1:<port>/` plus the link's part after `penpa-edit/`, unchanged. Most links carry their data as a query (`?m=solve&p=...`), not after `#`; two (000Q8D, 000PGF) use `#m=solve&p=...`. "Answer check yes" means `pu.solution` is non-empty. Every link booted in solve mode (`pu.mmode === "solve"`) with no page error and no `console.error`. "Modes" lists the mode buttons visible in solve mode (`#mo_<mode>_lb` shown); "all 12" is surface, multicolor, line, lineE, wall, cage, move, number, sudoku, symbol, special, combi. Size is the one the LMD page states, or Penpa's `pu.nx` x `pu.ny` when it states none. Difficulty is LMD's 1 to 5 rating.

Few LMD puzzles in these tags are the plain genre: most new ones are sudoku hybrids with SudokuPad links, and most Penpa+ ones are variants. The picks below are the plainest found with a Penpa+ link.
